build_train_config: build a TrainConfig dataclass to configure transformer model training with learning rate, batch sizes, and diffusion scheduler settings
create_multi_resolution_config: create a MultiResolutionConfig to set resolutions, batch sizes, num patches, and mask settings for multi-resolution training
configure_image_vae_training: configure an ImageVAEConfig to train an image VAE model with LPIPS, KL, and discriminator loss scales
configure_pose_vae_training: configure a PoseVAEConfig to train a pose VAE model with random ray augmentation and no LPIPS loss
use_basemethods_cli: use BaseMethods with tyro.cli to parse subcommands like train, train-image-vae, train-pose-vae, or debug from the command line
